description.value: Secluded lake in the Okanagan Highland east of Osoyoos, ringed by western larch and lodgepole pine, popular for rainbow trout fishing, swimming, and viewpoint hikes; both access routes are narrow, winding forest service roads (16–26 km from the highway) unsuitable for low-clearance vehicles.
